added: Kit shell activated on the real signed-in root and scope-reading routes: Workspaces→workspace→project→assessment navigation, search and expansion, language state and account/version controls through a read adapter over the existing controllers.
changed: Persona evidence: 15/15 root integration tests and 71/71 adapter/scope/identity-reset/shell unit tests passed at the exact accepted source; 25/25 synthetic menu hit and click checks across five viewport cases in an independent isolated browser. At the corrected source, 100 affected/anchor tests passed independently with 10 meaningful failures on the uncorrected parent, and 26 real headless Chrome journeys (16 title/route/host/viewport, 4 Retry, 4 delayed completion, 2 demo disclosure) passed at 390×900 and 1440×900. Real provider account journey untested; satisfaction, confusion and frustration NOT MEASURED.
fixed: Account menu stacks above the shell context on phone widths so Sign out and Use another account receive pointer input; header keeps its standard heights and no horizontal overflow at 195px.

Workspace, workspaces, projects and project pages keep their own visible heading when the kit shell is not hosting the page (non-kit entry such as /assess/); the kit host owns the title only when it is actually mounted.
The demonstration-data disclosure stays visible through kit repaints, navigation, search and expansion instead of disappearing on first render.

Every Retry control on a failed page is bound with one shared pending guard, so the second control (languages) works when assessments and languages both fail; stale retry results after navigation change nothing.
security: Existing authentication, permissions, account read, sign-out and participant routes are unchanged; no fixture data, global state or role simulation in product. Presentation only.
